title: The Missing Trophy
scenario: The school's championship trophy vanishes from a locked cabinet on the morning of the final. Three staff members were near the hall.

title: The Last Exhibition
scenario: A painter disappears during her own exhibition. The gallery was full, but nobody saw her leave. Four guests give conflicting accounts.

title: A Breach of Trust
scenario: Hours before a start-up launches its product, a rival publishes the exact same design. Five employees had access to different parts of the plans.
